fundamentals.name: Spotify Technology S.A.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Spotify Technology S.A., together with its subsidiaries, provides audio streaming subscription services worldwide. It operates in two segments, Premium and Ad-Supported. The Premium segment offers online and offline streaming access to its catalog of music and podcasts, including video, lossless music, and audiobooks in select markets through subscription offerings primarily sold directly to end users and partners. The Ad-Supported segment provides limited on-demand online access to its catalog of music and online and offline access to its catalog of podcasts on computers, tablets, mobile devices, and other smart devices. The company also offers sales, distribution and marketing, contract research and development, and customer and other support services. Spotify Technology S.A. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.

judgment.summary: Spotify demonstrates robust growth in earnings and revenue, coupled with strong margins and returns, despite a high debt-to-equity ratio.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat estimates by 18.0% with EPS of 3.45 vs 2.92; next earnings date is 2026-07-28.
positives: Revenue growth 8.2% YoY, with strong analyst estimates for current Q and FY.
Exceptional earnings growth of 222.4% YoY and 220.4% for the last quarter.
Healthy margins with Gross margin at 32.3%, Operating margin at 15.8%, and Profit margin at 15.4%.
High Return on Equity of 38.0% and Return on Assets of 11.6%.
Positive Free Cash Flow of $707.75M TTM.
negatives: High Debt/Equity ratio of 5.94, although total debt is relatively low compared to cash.
Stock price has dropped 14% year-to-date, indicating recent negative price action.
PEG ratio of 1.68 suggests growth may be priced in.

news.paragraph: Spotify (SPOT) is seeing a mixed sentiment, with one analyst remaining positive despite a 14% year-to-date drop, while another article notes the stock ascending while the broader market falls. The company's strong earnings growth and positive analyst consensus suggest underlying strength, though the recent price action and market conditions warrant caution. The upcoming earnings report will be key to assessing forward momentum.
